page.overview:
Who is Regulus Black?

Regulus Arcturus Black (1961 – Late 1979) was an English pure-blood wizard, the youngest son of Orion and Walburga Black, and the younger brother of Sirius Black. He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1972 and was Sorted into the Slytherin house.

Regulus became a Death Eater in his youth but defected when he found what Lord Voldemort would do in order to reach his aims. Regulus also learned about one of Voldemort's Horcruxes and decided to destroy it. He was killed after acquiring Salazar Slytherin's locket in late 1979.

Regulus was born in 1961 into the wealthy, pure-blooded Black family, as the youngest son of Orion and Walburga Black and younger brother of Sirius Black. It is assumed that he was named after his great-uncle, who was also named Regulus, and his paternal grandfather, Arcturus.

His cousins, a trio of sisters from his mother's side — the daughters of Cygnus (III) and Druella Black (née Rosier) — were Bellatrix (later Lestrange), Andromeda (later Tonks), and Narcissa Black (later Malfoy). Bellatrix would later become a loyal Death Eater of Lord Voldemort's, Andromeda would marry the Muggle-born Edward Tonks and subsequently get disowned by the family, and Narcissa would marry Death Eater Lucius Malfoy and give birth to Draco Malfoy, Regulus's first cousin once removed.
